tools.name: Merge PDF
tools.title: Merge PDF Files Free Online — Combine PDFs | EazyPDF
tools.description: Combine multiple PDF files into one document in your browser. Drag to reorder, no upload to any server, no file limits, completely free.

faqs.q: Does merging PDFs upload my files anywhere?
faqs.a: No. Merge PDF runs entirely in your browser using pdf-lib — your files never leave your device.

faqs.q: Is there a limit on how many PDFs I can merge?
faqs.a: No artificial limit. The only constraint is your browser's available memory for very large batches.

faqs.q: Can I reorder pages before merging?
faqs.a: Yes, drag files into the order you want before combining them into the final PDF.

hero.valueProp: Combine PDF reports, statements, scans, and forms into one file — dragged into the order you want, processed on your own device.

whyUse.intro: Merging comes up whenever a single PDF needs to hold what started as several separate files.

points.title: One file to send instead of many
points.desc: Attaching five separate scans to an email invites at least one of them to get lost or opened out of order. One merged PDF removes that risk entirely.

points.title: Reports built from separate sections
points.desc: When a report is drafted in pieces — cover page, chapters, appendix — merging is how those pieces become the single document you actually submit.

points.title: Scanned pages that arrived as separate files
points.desc: A scanner or phone scanning app often saves each page as its own PDF. Merge PDF turns that pile back into one ordered document.

tools.name: Rotate PDF
tools.title: Rotate PDF Pages Free Online — Fix Orientation | EazyPDF
tools.description: Rotate individual pages or the entire PDF 90, 180 or 270 degrees. Free, fast, and processed entirely in your browser.
tools.shortDesc: Rotate any page, or all pages, to the correct orientation.

faqs.q: Can I rotate just one page instead of the whole document?
faqs.a: Yes, select individual pages in the page grid and rotate only those, independently of the rest.

faqs.q: What rotation angles are supported?
faqs.a: 90°, 180°, and 270° in either direction, per page or applied to all pages at once.

faqs.q: Will rotating reduce PDF quality?
faqs.a: No, the page content itself is untouched — only its orientation metadata changes.

tools.name: Delete Pages
tools.title: Delete Pages from PDF Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Remove unwanted pages from a PDF in a few clicks. Preview every page first. Free, browser-based, no uploads.
tools.shortDesc: Remove one or more pages from a PDF, with a visual preview.

faqs.q: Can I preview pages before deleting them?
faqs.a: Yes, every page renders as a thumbnail so you can confirm before removing anything.

faqs.q: Can I delete multiple non-consecutive pages at once?
faqs.a: Yes, select any combination of pages and remove them together in one pass.

faqs.q: Is the original file changed?
faqs.a: No, your source file is untouched — EazyPDF generates a new PDF for download.

tools.name: Extract Pages
tools.title: Extract Pages from PDF Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Pull specific pages out of a PDF into a new document. Visual page picker, free, and processed locally in your browser.
tools.shortDesc: Pick exactly the pages you need and save them as a new PDF.

faqs.q: How is this different from Split PDF?
faqs.a: Extract Pages keeps only the pages you pick into one new file; Split PDF divides the whole document into multiple output files.

faqs.q: Can I extract non-consecutive pages into one file?
faqs.a: Yes, select any set of pages and they're combined, in order, into a single extracted PDF.

faqs.q: Does this work on scanned PDFs?
faqs.a: Yes, extraction works on any valid PDF, including scanned documents, since it copies pages rather than reading text.

tools.name: Organize PDF
tools.title: Organize & Reorder PDF Pages Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Drag and drop to reorder, rotate, or remove PDF pages in one visual workspace. Free, browser-based, no file uploads.
tools.shortDesc: Drag to reorder, rotate, or delete pages in one workspace.

faqs.q: Can I reorder, rotate, and delete pages in the same step?
faqs.a: Yes, Organize PDF combines all three actions in one page-grid workspace before you save.

faqs.q: Is drag-and-drop reordering supported on mobile?
faqs.a: Yes, the page grid supports touch dragging in addition to mouse and keyboard.

faqs.q: Do I need to install anything?
faqs.a: No, everything runs in your browser tab — no install, no account.

tools.name: Crop PDF
tools.title: Crop PDF Pages Free Online — Trim Margins | EazyPDF
tools.description: Crop margins or unwanted areas from PDF pages with a visual crop box. Apply to one page or the whole document, free.
tools.shortDesc: Draw a crop box and trim margins from any or all pages.

faqs.q: Can I apply the same crop to every page?
faqs.a: Yes, set the crop box once and apply it across the whole document, or crop individual pages differently.

faqs.q: Can I zoom in for a precise crop?
faqs.a: Yes, the crop workspace supports zoom and page-by-page navigation for accuracy.

faqs.q: Is cropping reversible?
faqs.a: Cropping changes the page's visible area in the output file; keep your original PDF if you may need the untrimmed version later.

tools.name: Watermark PDF
tools.title: Add Watermark to PDF Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Add a text watermark to your PDF with live preview — control position, opacity, size and rotation. Free, no uploads.
tools.shortDesc: Stamp a text watermark across every page, with live preview.

faqs.q: Can I preview the watermark before saving?
faqs.a: Yes, position, opacity, size and rotation all update in a live preview as you adjust them.

faqs.q: Can I control how transparent the watermark is?
faqs.a: Yes, opacity is adjustable so the watermark can be subtle or bold.

faqs.q: Does the watermark apply to every page automatically?
faqs.a: Yes, by default it's applied to all pages using the same settings.

tools.name: Add Page Numbers
tools.title: Add Page Numbers to PDF Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Insert page numbers into a PDF with control over position, starting number and format. Free, live preview, no uploads.
tools.shortDesc: Insert page numbers with your choice of position and format.

faqs.q: Can I start numbering from a page other than 1?
faqs.a: Yes, set any starting number, which is useful when this file is part of a larger combined document.

faqs.q: Where can page numbers be placed?
faqs.a: Choose from common positions such as bottom-center, bottom-right, or top-right, with a live preview.

faqs.q: Can I exclude the first page, like a cover page?
faqs.a: Yes, numbering options let you skip the cover page while numbering the rest.

tools.name: Protect PDF
tools.title: Password Protect PDF Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Add a password to a PDF to restrict opening or editing. Free, browser-based encryption — see the tool for encryption details.
tools.shortDesc: Add an open or permissions password to a PDF file.

faqs.q: How strong is the encryption?
faqs.a: Protect PDF uses the PDF format's original Standard Security Handler (40-bit RC4). It's suitable as basic access control, not as strong confidentiality for highly sensitive documents.

faqs.q: Is my file uploaded to encrypt it?
faqs.a: No, encryption happens locally in your browser — the file and password are never sent anywhere.

faqs.q: Can I restrict printing or editing without a password to open?
faqs.a: Yes, permission flags can be set independently of the open password, though they're honored only by readers that respect them.

tools.name: Compress PDF
tools.title: Compress PDF to Target Size Free Online | EazyPDF
tools.description: Shrink a PDF's file size down to an exact KB target you set. Free, fast, entirely in-browser compression.
tools.shortDesc: Shrink file size down to an exact KB target you set.

faqs.q: Can I choose exactly how small the file becomes?
faqs.a: Yes, set a target file size in KB and Compress PDF works toward that size.

faqs.q: Does compression reduce image quality?
faqs.a: Images are re-encoded to hit the target size, so very aggressive targets can visibly reduce image quality.

faqs.q: Is there a file size limit for compressing?
faqs.a: No hard limit is enforced, though very large files depend on your browser's available memory.

hero.valueProp: Reduce PDF size without losing quality — set a target size in KB and let Compress PDF do the rest, in your browser.

whyUse.intro: Compression matters whenever a file's size, not its content, is the problem.

points.title: Storage add up fast
